notes.title: A Near Dawn: Prologue (our Demo) has been released!
notes.content:
Hey guys, we are really excited to finally share with you the Prologue to our dark adventure A Near Dawn. You can now download and play it on Steam - just hit "Download Demo"!

Please let us know your thoughts, we would love to hear from you!
